metadata.title: Apply Changes
metadata.purposeAndUsage: Apply all user-approved changes to relevant files based on approved change proposals. Use after changes have been proposed and approved to execute the modifications.

output.description: Modified files and change application report

prerequisites: Approved change proposals from previous step
Change proposals document with detailed instructions
specificActions: Read approved change proposals from memory (IDs list and document path)
Read change proposals document to get detailed instructions
For each approved change: read target file, apply change, verify applied correctly
Create change application report documenting all changes

read: memory.json (previous step section: approved change IDs list, change proposals document path)
Change proposals document (path from memory.json reference)
Target files that need changes applied

tools: read_file - Read memory.json, change proposals document, target files
search_replace - Apply changes that modify existing content
write - Apply changes that create new files or replace content
read_file - Verify changes were applied correctly after modification
bestPractices: ALWAYS verify batch coverage first - ensure all identified files/categories are covered before starting
If batch coverage check fails, STOP and report the gap before proceeding
Read approved change proposals systematically - process each approved change ID
For each approved change, read the target file to understand current state before applying
Apply changes exactly as specified in the change instructions
Verify each change was applied correctly by reading the file after modification
Log progress for each change applied
Document all changes in the change application report

substeps.name: Init-Step: Confirm Principles
substeps.description: Recall operating principles before starting this step
actions: Read `.processes/steps/_components/operating-principles.md` and recall all principles
Output: '✓ Principles confirmed for this step'

substeps.name: Verify Batch Coverage
substeps.description: Ensure all identified files are covered in the implementation plan before starting
actions: Read identified-files list from memory (from identify-files step output)
Count files per category from identified-files (e.g., steps: 27, templates: 6)
Read implementation plan batch breakdown from memory or plan document
Compare category counts: verify all categories are listed in batch breakdown
If any category is missing or count mismatch: STOP and report gap to user
Log: 'Batch coverage verified: {categories} categories, {total} files covered'

substeps.name: Read Approved Change Proposals from Memory
substeps.description: Get approved change IDs and document path from memory
actions: Read from memory.json previous step section: Approved change IDs list, Change proposals document path reference
Verify approved change IDs list is available and not empty
Log in log.json: 'Found {count} approved changes to apply'

substeps.name: Read Change Proposals Document
substeps.description: Extract detailed change instructions for each approved change
actions: Read the change proposals document using the path from memory.json
For each approved change ID, extract: Change ID, location, current state, proposed change, instructions, rationale
Log: 'Read change proposals document, extracted details for {count} approved changes'

substeps.name: Apply Each Approved Change
substeps.description: Apply each change to target files and verify
actions: For each approved change:
Log progress: 'Applying change {change ID} ({current} of {total})'
Read target file to understand current state and verify it matches proposal
Apply change using search_replace (modify) or write (create/replace)
Verify change was applied correctly by reading file after modification
Log: 'Applied change {change ID} to {file path}'

substeps.name: Create Change Application Report
substeps.description: Create report documenting all changes applied
actions: Create changes-applied.md with: Header, Summary (total changes, files modified, status)
For each change: Change ID, file path, description, status
List of all files modified with change counts
Log: 'Created changes-applied.md report'

substeps.name: Update Memory with Results
substeps.description: Update memory with change application results
actions: Record: Change application report path, Total changes applied, List of files modified
Log completion: 'Step complete - {count} changes applied to {count} files'

substeps.name: End-Step: Compliance Check
substeps.description: Verify principles were followed in this step
actions: Verify: Was log.json updated for any user interactions?
Verify: Were mandatory actions confirmed with output?

Record processWideObservations: add any patterns detected during change application to patternsDetected, add efficiency metrics (changes applied, files modified, verification pass/fail counts) to efficiencyMetrics
Output: '✓ Step completed in compliance with operating principles'

flow.description: Verify batch coverage → Read approved IDs from memory → Read proposals document → Apply each change → Verify each change → Create report → Update memory

memoryFileUsage.readFrom: Previous step section (approved change IDs list, change proposals document path)
fields: Information Produced: Change application report path, Total changes applied, List of files modified
Decisions Made: Any decisions during application
Files Modified/Created: List of all changed files, changes-applied.md
